title: Tosheroon
description: Real-time Amazon prices, product search, 90-day history, AI forecasts, and price drop alerts.
summary: Real-time Amazon prices, product search, 90-day history, AI forecasts, and price drop alerts.
offersHint: Real-time Amazon prices, product search, 90-day history, AI forecasts, and price drop alerts. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://tosheroon.com/mcp · Optional headers: X-Api-Key

headers.name: X-Api-Key
headers.description: Optional API key for higher rate limits (120/min vs 20/min). Get one at https://tosheroon.com/tools/mcp

headerDocs.name: X-Api-Key
headerDocs.description: Optional API key for higher rate limits (120/min vs 20/min). Get one at https://tosheroon.com/tools/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_products
toolsPreview.description: Search for Amazon products by keyword, ASIN, or Amazon URL with optional filters for brand, category, price range, stock status, and sorting. Returns product IDs for use with other tools. Rate limited to 20 req/min without an API key — use the register_api_key tool for 120 req/min.

toolsPreview.name: get_product
toolsPreview.description: Get detailed product information by product_id. Returns full product details including current price and affiliate buy link.

toolsPreview.name: get_price_history
toolsPreview.description: Get price history for a product by product_id. Returns daily prices for up to 90 days.

toolsPreview.name: get_price_drops
toolsPreview.description: Get Amazon products with recent significant price drops. Returns products sorted by drop percentage.

toolsPreview.name: browse_by_category
toolsPreview.description: Browse Amazon products by category. Omit category to list all available categories. Provide a category name to get products in that category.

toolsPreview.name: browse_by_brand
toolsPreview.description: Browse Amazon products by brand name. Returns products matching the given brand.

toolsPreview.name: get_price_statistics
toolsPreview.description: Get price statistics for a product (all-time high/low, mean, median, histogram). Uses cached data for performance.

toolsPreview.name: get_price_forecast
toolsPreview.description: Get a 30-day price forecast for a product. Requires sufficient price history. Returns predicted prices with confidence scores.

toolsPreview.name: create_price_alert
toolsPreview.description: Create a price drop alert. You'll receive an email when the product drops to or below your target price.

toolsPreview.name: create_in_stock_alert
toolsPreview.description: Create a back-in-stock alert. You'll receive an email when the product becomes available again.

toolsPreview.name: get_similar_products
toolsPreview.description: Find products similar to a given product. Useful for discovering alternatives or related items.

toolsPreview.name: register_api_key
toolsPreview.description: Register for a free API key to increase your rate limits from 20/min to 120/min. An API key will be emailed to you.
